question: For 21 already source-labelled 18–24ka calibrated BP taxonid1299 positive-datum samples across five original Neotoma pollen datasets, do full official chronology objects with EXACT sample.ages.chronologyid exist and what calibration/age-model provenance and date controls are stated?

matching.required_key: datasetid exact AND sample.ages.chronologyid exact numeric, never infer by age alone
matching.outcome: source chronology object present/missing; original chronology agtype vs source sample age agtype consistency; chronology controls number/source dating age types; original citation review flags
matching.strict_reporting: A matching chronologyid validates database STRUCTURAL linkage but not calibration model quality or taxon diagnostic pollen identification.
matching.no_false_reclassification: A source chronology mismatch or timeout is source unknown/conflict, not proof ancient plant absent.
matching.no_cherry_picking: All six original fixed datasets and all 21 candidate-age rows reported, including 20 missing original age uncertainty bounds.

limits: No independently calibrated or externally audited 21ka occupied Alnus glutinosa host population may be inferred.
Original v13 26 occurrence IDs remain unjoined to exact sample IDs; v17 fake-occurrenceID echo ruled out assuming endpoint ID verifies source existence.
